div.p: Configure the GL accounts used when posting Subcontractor IPC journal entries. These settings apply to all IPCs in this company. Each IPC still allows per-entry overrides for the expense account, payable account, and journal.

field.name: expense_account_id
field.help: GL account debited for certified work done (Dr side). Auto-fills on new IPCs.

field.name: payable_account_id
field.help: Default subcontractor payable account (Cr side — hits partner ledger). Override per-IPC or set on the subcontractor partner.

field.name: journal_id
field.help: Journal for all IPC accounting entries. Falls back to first General journal if not set.

group.div: How these work: When an IPC is submitted, a multi-line journal entry is posted. Each deduction that has an account configured here gets its own credit line. Any deductions without a configured account are folded into the Subcontractor Payable credit (the JE always balances).

field.name: retention_payable_account_id
field.help: Liability account for retention withheld (e.g. 5%). Credited in IPC JE; debited when released.

field.name: mob_advance_account_id
field.help: Asset account for mobilisation advances. Debited when advance is given; credited in IPC JE as it is recovered.

field.name: security_withheld_account_id
field.help: Liability account for security deposits withheld. Credited in IPC JE; debited when returned.

field.name: backcharge_recovery_account_id
field.help: Account credited when back charges are recovered from a subcontractor.

field.name: other_deductions_account_id
field.help: Account credited for the Other Deductions line in IPCs.
